questions.prompt: Nikola Jokić won 2023 Finals MVP. What did he average in points per game?
questions.context: 2023 NBA Finals · Denver Nuggets vs Miami Heat
questions.note: 30.2 points per game while leading Denver to its first title.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 30.2 points, 14.0 rebounds, 7.2 assists, and 1.4 blocks

funFacts.text: Jokić became Denver's first Finals MVP, with every voter agreeing on the award.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Denver's Nikola Jokić was unanimously voted the NBA Finals Most Valuable Player

funFacts.text: Jokić's Finals stat line included 14.0 rebounds, 7.2 assists, and 1.4 blocks per game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: after averaging 30.2 points, 14.0 rebounds, 7.2 assists, and 1.4 blocks

funFacts.text: Denver became only the second franchise from the old ABA to win an NBA title, following the Spurs.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They became the second former American Basketball Association (ABA) team to win an NBA title

questions.prompt: Steve Kerr's 2022 title was his ninth overall. How many did he win as a player?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr won his ninth championship overall, after winning five as a player.

funFacts.text: Kerr's Warriors had the NBA's worst record only a few seasons before reclaiming the championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Warriors also became the first team to go from the NBA's worst record

funFacts.text: The championship earned Kerr a place among the select coaches to win four NBA titles.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He became the sixth coach to capture four titles

funFacts.text: Kerr's lineup adjustment in Boston temporarily replaced Draymond Green with rebounding specialist Kevon Looney.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Steve Kerr benched him for parts of the fourth quarter, while Looney remained on the floor

questions.prompt: Through the first three games of the 1975 Finals, how many points did Golden State's bench score?
questions.note: 115, to Washington's 53, on the way to a sweep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Warriors' bench players had outscored the Bullets' reserves 115–53

funFacts.text: Golden State had to host part of the Finals at the Cow Palace because the Ice Follies occupied its arena.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Oakland facility being unavailable due to the Ice Follies

funFacts.text: Jamaal Wilkes's defense against Elvin Hayes helped neutralize Washington's frontcourt advantage.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the defensive play of the seemingly undersized Jamaal Wilkes on Bullets' power forward Elvin Hayes

funFacts.text: Backup center George Johnson provided timely scoring and rebounding during the Warriors' surprise sweep.

questions.prompt: What was San Antonio's total home attendance in the shortened 1998–99 season?
questions.note: 527,357 attended Spurs home games despite the shorter schedule.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: an attendance of 527,357 at the Alamodome during the regular season

funFacts.text: The Spurs ranked second in home attendance during the season, trailing only Chicago.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs finished second in the NBA in home-game attendance behind the Chicago Bulls

funFacts.text: The season ended with the first NBA championship in San Antonio franchise history.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Spurs defeated the Knicks in five games to win their first NBA championship.

funFacts.text: The entire league had to play a compressed calendar after the lockout delayed opening night.
